brief_summary: The purpose of this project is to compare two pharmacist-led population management strategies designed to increase the rate of appropriate monitoring of vitamin B12 and serum creatinine for patients taking metformin.
brief_title: Comparison of Two Pharmacist-led Population Management Approaches to Increase Monitoring of Vitamin B12 and Serum Creatinine Levels for Patients on Metformin

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* On Metformin for at least one year
* Activated patient portal for electronic messaging
* Patient of an attending physician at Ohio State General Internal Medicine
* No serum vitamin B12 and/or no serum creatinine measurement in the past year

official_title: Comparison of Two Pharmacist-led Population Management Approaches to Increase Monitoring of Vitamin B12 and Serum Creatinine Levels for Patients on Metformin

primary_outcomes.measure: Percentage of patients in each arm who obtain monitoring of vitamin B12 as recommended

sites.facility: The Ohio State University General Internal Medicine
